name: Ozzu MVP API
description: Ozzu MVP OpenAPI 3.0 spec including MVP flows (Registration/Login/Spotlight/Event Page), LCM endpoints (Domain/Event/Series/Teams/Players/Wager Cards), Wager creation, Scoped Referents, Lounges + Event Lounges + Lounge Entries + Lounge Membership moderation, and flexible internalProperties on all domain objects.
